title: Most babies pick up small bits with thumb and pointer by about 1 year
summary: Most babies pick things up between thumb and pointer finger by about 1 year, the US CDC says.
body: The CDC 1-year movement list says picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food. The thumb and the pointer finger meet on a small piece. The page files this under movement, with what most babies do by one year. This card is that pinch. It is not a lesson about meals. The month comes from the US CDC list, which other countries need not copy.

sources.title: Milestones by 1 Year
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food.
